units.source_text: 十字架的血迹未干，第三天耶稣基督升天了。

en.t: Before the blood on the cross had dried, on the third day Jesus Christ ascended into heaven.

units.source_text: 忽然两个人站在旁边，衣服放光。

en.t: Suddenly two men stood beside them, their clothes shining with light.
The women were terrified and bowed their faces to the ground.

units.source_text: 那两个人就对她们说：“为什么在死人中找活人呢？

en.t: The two men said to them, "Why do you look for the living among the dead?

units.source_text: 他不在这里，已经复活了。

en.t: He is not here; he has risen.

units.source_text: 当他还在加利利的时候怎样告诉你们，说：‘人子必须被交在罪人手里，钉在十字架上，第三日复活。’”

en.t: Remember how he told you, while he was still in Galilee, saying, 'The Son of Man must be handed over into the hands of sinners, be crucified, and rise on the third day.'"
